title: Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards Rental Activity and Ridgeline Tool Rental Downtime Credits
content:
Frequent tool renters in Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards receive a larger Ridgeline Tool Rental downtime credit.

**Rule.** ProBuild rental activity raises the credit: when the renter's ProBuild membership shows 5 or more tool rental spend postings dated fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the day the credit is booked, the credit is multiplied by 1.10; when it shows 2 to 4 such postings, by 1.05; when it shows fewer than 2, it is unchanged.

The postings counted are the spend postings on the Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership whose purchase channel is tool rental; each posting counts once, whatever its amount. The credit is multiplied before it is rounded, and the rounding to the cent is made only on the final figure.

## Activity table

| Tool rental spend postings in the window | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 5 or more | 1.10 |
| 2, 3 or 4 | 1.05 |
| 0 or 1 | 1 (unchanged) |

## Hypothetical readings (credit booked on 20 August 2026)

| Tool rental spend postings dated | Counted | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 21 August 2025 and four more in 2026 | 5 | 1.10 |
| 20 August 2025 and 3 March 2026 | 1 (20 August 2025 is 12 whole months before) | 1 |
| 4 January, 9 May, 1 July 2026 | 3 | 1.05 |
